operation: On the v2 backing: a seeded Show with one Clip (Clone Sharing Rings, 0-5 s, main Layer). Select it and press the toolbar Clone. The first capture is the editor after Clone: a second Clip at 5-10 s on the same Layer, and the inspector shows 'Shared by 2 Clips'. Then press Make Pattern Independent on the selected copy. The second capture shows 'Independent', with the Rejoin instance row offered. The third renders the stored v2 record (GET /api/shows) read back in the same run: before; after Clone (the copy has the same instanceId); after Make Independent (the copy has a fresh instanceId, and the instance count goes from 1 to 2).
